params.body: Replaces the per-project Remote Control servers with one entry point in `~/Projects` (`claude-rc-workspace`), and `projects-sync` (hourly) keeps all 42 repositories Portal links cloned and fetched, writing `PROJECTS.md`. The core says how a session there finds its project and that it works in its own worktree. Proposed from the workbench at home.
params.title: One entry point: a session in ~/Projects finds its project first
